fields.statement: At 5b3ccbe9 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh scratch repo, RHIZA_* unset, hold workflow keeping runs unfinished: a normal (non-autonomous) plan run with a clean review round and accept auto (default): RHIZA_RUN=<run> rhiza run gate exited 0, said 'Gated the plan of normal run' and both served change sets went proposed then accepted; change show records rule autonomy, reason 'rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto, run <id>'. With git config rhiza.autonomy.accept owner the same gate exited 0, left the change set proposed with next rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>. With accept auto and no review round at all, the gate exited 0 and left it proposed with the owner accept next. rhiza check passed after. Scoped testscripts owner-run-gate-accept, run-gate, autonomous-gate-rule, stage-autonomy pass.

At 5b3ccbe9 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh scratch repo, RHIZA_* unset, hold workflow keeping runs unfinished: rhiza accept --rule autonomy inside an unfinished normal run with rhiza.autonomy.accept owner was refused, exit 2, 'rhiza.autonomy.accept is owner, so only the owner accepts'; with accept auto but RHIZA_RUN unset refused, exit 2, 'only for a move made inside a run, and RHIZA_RUN is not set'; rule autonomous in the normal run still refused, exit 2, 'is not autonomous'; the gate's accept under accept auto recorded rule autonomy. autonomy-accept-rule testscript passes.

At 5b3ccbe9 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh scratch repo, RHIZA_* unset, hold workflow keeping runs unfinished: after a normal plan run's gate with accept owner left a change set proposed, rhiza inbox listed it as 'accept run <run>, change set <id> / waiting for acceptance / next: rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>'; running that next accepted it (Rule: owner) and the item left the inbox. A normal run whose gate left a proposal for want of a review round (accept auto) also listed it. inbox-owner-run-accept testscript passes.
